probe_calibration.note: Empty begin/end record calibration only; does not include all function wrapper, frame sampling, render-query or serialization overhead. Never subtract as claimed savings.

cpu_method: Windows GetProcessTimes user+kernel summed over threads of verified sole Godot game child of owned console launcher. Both CPU marks use file ACK; actual CPU windows bracket the timed frame interval by approximately1ms. CPU and GPU never added.
sampling_and_storage: Per-frame in-memory counter/render query/list capture costs are measured in sampling_us. This sum conservatively includes the last capture after the final frame timestamp.

No per-frame disk writes or prints. JSON serialization, canonical kernel export, screenshots and evidence compression occur after CPU end ACK and outside frame intervals. CPU ACK setup/waits are outside frame interval and explicitly reported.

Initial clean CPU scope read only console launcher; its zero delta is invalid, not a claim of zero CPU. Corrected four profile samples plus final clean A5 read actual rendering process and assert positive CPU delta.
Corrected CPU sampler reused existing verified frame/state samples; there is no new natural scenario or algorithm comparison.
timing_limits: Script spans are mutually-exclusive synchronous wall-clock execution intervals, useful as occupied script time but not exact per-function thread CPU; preemption/API stalls can occur inside them.
GetProcessTimes reports aggregate actual process CPU independently; it cannot be partitioned by subtracting wall-clock script spans because other threads can overlap.

render_submission_gpu_wait_unsplit includes rendering-server/driver CPU submission, GPU completion and possible driver/OS waiting. Viewport CPU/GPU timestamps overlap and cannot uniquely divide that window. Disabling software/VSync limits removes those intentional caps but does not prove zero driver wait.

Process CPU values show approximately15.625ms granularity in this run; sample boundary skew is reported. Empty begin/end estimate omits wrapper and other observer overhead, so no corrected-performance claim is made.
Detailed A is within clean A drift. Profile vs clean B/C/D changes include observer cost and drift; no single subtraction identifies full probe perturbation.
interpretation: Clean B/C/D are10.13/8.97/4.01ms rather than the old capped16.7ms. These are dependency-removal measurements with reduced presentation, never shipping optimization claims.

All480 logic steps and events/RNG/state are equal, but display counts differ greatly. Corrected detailed CPU per logic step is16.73/16.57/16.57/16.47ms and CPU per game second remains about988-1004ms; unrestricted render loops consume freed capacity in additional display frames.
Detailed zero-step fractions are0/35.73/44.20/76.90percent. Snapshot/visual/UI work is frame-driven, so lower per-frame figures alone cannot establish reduced total work per game second.

Full-view snapshot plus display_frame remains about2.44ms/frame gross scope. Required computations, lifecycle/maintenance and synchronization are not eliminated by a full-quality implementation. No demonstrated net >1ms candidate is implemented.
Remaining unresolved attribution is specifically inside the rendering submission/driver/GPU completion window; no blind extra runs are proposed.
